title: Infernux v0.4.3-v4 · Hotfix 4: Character Geometry and Color Composition
codename: Hotfix 4: Character Geometry and Color Composition
summary: This hotfix completes the native text interfaces used by the independent animation plugins. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; wheels use build 4, with the matching Hub bundle at 0.4.3-5.

items.title: Add per-grapheme three-dimensional affine transforms and four-corner depth offsets. Screen text projects the transformed geometry; world text preserves depth through its retained draw packets, clipping and GPU vertex attributes.
items.text: Add per-grapheme three-dimensional affine transforms and four-corner depth offsets. Screen text projects the transformed geometry; world text preserves depth through its retained draw packets, clipping and GPU vertex attributes.

items.title: Compose the Manual, Effects and Appearance layers in order. Corner edits remain usable at zero scale and when another layer rotates or scales the character.
items.text: Compose the Manual, Effects and Appearance layers in order. Corner edits remain usable at zero scale and when another layer rotates or scales the character.

items.title: Separate absolute character RGB and alpha overrides from ordinary layer tint. Alpha-only animation preserves rich-text colors, including multiple colored glyphs belonging to one grapheme. Reset restores the authored colors.
items.text: Separate absolute character RGB and alpha overrides from ordinary layer tint. Alpha-only animation preserves rich-text colors, including multiple colored glyphs belonging to one grapheme. Reset restores the authored colors.

items.title: Apply parent and element opacity independently from character alpha, and retain material tint in both runtime rendering and UI Editor previews. Characters can become visible after an authored zero-alpha base color.
items.text: Apply parent and element opacity independently from character alpha, and retain material tint in both runtime rendering and UI Editor previews. Characters can become visible after an authored zero-alpha base color.

items.title: Treat text inside rich-text <noparse> spans as literal content while retaining original source offsets and the surrounding text styles.
items.text: Treat text inside rich-text <noparse> spans as literal content while retaining original source offsets and the surrounding text styles.

items.title: Rebuild the matching Windows, Linux, Android and Web Player packages for these native interfaces.
items.text: Rebuild the matching Windows, Linux, Android and Web Player packages for these native interfaces.

items.title: Return a valid identity rotation for zero forward vectors and a normalized forward rotation for collinear or zero up vectors in Quaternion.look_rotation.
items.text: Return a valid identity rotation for zero forward vectors and a normalized forward rotation for collinear or zero up vectors in Quaternion.look_rotation.

items.title: Make quaternion angle and rotation-towards calculations agree for opposite-sign representations of the same rotation; correct the quaternion constructor default in the Python type stub.
items.text: Make quaternion angle and rotation-towards calculations agree for opposite-sign representations of the same rotation; correct the quaternion constructor default in the Python type stub.

items.title: Read string-valued Enum members through their declared values in semantic field descriptions, so plugin controls do not fail by coercing them to integers.
items.text: Read string-valued Enum members through their declared values in semantic field descriptions, so plugin controls do not fail by coercing them to integers.

items.title: Keep inherited component type identities separate from asset GUIDs in the Player dependency catalog, so valid plugin inheritance does not block builds while missing script dependencies remain errors.
items.text: Keep inherited component type identities separate from asset GUIDs in the Player dependency catalog, so valid plugin inheritance does not block builds while missing script dependencies remain errors.
